description: This Java class 'ProgramEditor' extends PropertyEditorSupport and provides mechanisms for serializing and deserializing 'Program' objects to and from strings within the Spring framework. It interprets string inputs to fetch 'Program' objects by ID or UUID, and converts 'Program' objects back to their ID string representations. The class interacts with OpenMRS services to retrieve concepts and programs, and handles errors if a program cannot be found.

classes.name: ProgramEditor
classes.description: A property editor for serializing and deserializing 'Program' objects, allowing them to be referenced by ID or UUID in string form within Spring-based Java applications.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Converts a string input into a Program object, interpreting the string as a concept ID, concept UUID, program ID, or program UUID, and sets the value accordingly.

methods.name: getAsText
methods.description: Returns the program ID of the current Program object as a string, or an empty string if the value is null.
